issuer: the municipality's Borgerservice, with the driving tests held by the Danish Road Traffic Authority (Færdselsstyrelsen)
note: Read 2026-10-30. borger.dk gives category B from 17 or 18 (at 17 only in accompanied driving until 18, not held), so a full licence is kept from 18; its renewal page says licences for cars issued after 19 January 2013 are valid for 15 years as a rule. Færdselsstyrelsen's price list (2026) gives the driving test for a car at 1,600 kr., including the 200 kr. surcharge the Road Traffic Act sets; the list has no separate fee for issuing a first licence (a temporary licence costs 0 kr.), so the test's fee is the one held. The theory test, the driving school and the medical certificate aren't held. The municipal identity card (legitimationskort) is the ids engine's, not held here. The exchange list (group 1 and group 2 countries) wasn't read.

sources.title: borger.dk, Kørekort – de forskellige kategorier
sources.said: B: Personbil og varebil (17 eller 18 år)

sources.title: borger.dk, Forny dit kørekort
sources.said: Kørekort til stor knallert, motorcykel, bil og trailer, som er udstedt efter den 19. januar 2013, er som udgangspunkt gyldig i 15 år.

sources.title: Færdselsstyrelsen, Priser på kørekort
sources.said: Køreprøve til bil ... B* ... 1.600 kr. ... Der er et tillæg på 200 kr. til køreprøver, som er inkluderet i ovenstående priser. ... Midlertidigt kørekort
